enchantments.tooltip: Strength +7: This item gives the wearer the power of Ogre Strength, granting a +7 Enhancement bonus to Strength.
Insightful Seeker +3: Provides a +3 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +3 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Quality Seeker +1: Provides a +1 Quality bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +1 Quality bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Will Save +7: This item gives a +7 Resistance bonus to your Will saves.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
